gen-dafont-origami-gf-michroma: Neon-tube lettering glows up top in Origami, every stroke held to a single line thickness, while Michroma gives each letter a wide berth below as a plain sans.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-miriam-libre: Contemporary and a bit unusual, Origami lays down single-stroke brush letters. Miriam Libre follows with an s that opens generously, drawn like fine wire, so it feels approachable beside the heavier heading.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Neutral in temperament, Mochiy Pop One hangs its large-eyed lowercase like clothespins on a line. Origami earns its keep big and brief, where its brush-drawn single stroke can stand alone.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Origami looks like a sign-painter's brush held at constant width. Beside it, Mochiy Pop P One brings wide gaps between letters and a sizable lowercase, with no pointed-brush swell anywhere.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-montserrat-underli: Montserrat Underline reads as a sans with breathing counters and round bowls that never swell or thin out. Origami, in contrast, brings poured-lead lowercase mass and single-stroke brush lines, so give it generous size up top.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal. Origami, with its plain unshaded lines and sign-painter's brush feel, earns its keep when set big and short.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-mozilla-text: Neutral and quietly sturdy, Mozilla Text has tall bodies that make its lowercase look bold, with terminals flaring outward. Origami does its best work with identical stems and arches at display size, while Mozilla Text does its best in steady running lines.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-nata-sans: Single-stroke brush lettering with a lead-type heft, that is Origami at a glance. Nata Sans answers with a large central band and wide-mouthed curves, drawn with a technical pen's steadiness.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-nobile: Nobile keeps its lowercase close to cap height and leaves its letter mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs, so text moves along smoothly. Origami's fixed-pen strokes stay out front.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-nokora: Unvarying line thickness defines Origami, a brush-sign look with poured-lead lowercase mass. And Nokora counters with a wide-open s and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line.
